title: Locating someone's will
summary: This page provides information on what a will is and where to look if you need to locate a deceased person's will.
intro:
A will is a legal document that sets out how someone wants their assets distributed after they die.

People usually keep a copy of their will at one or more of the following locations:

Legal Aid NSW has sample letters to help you.

NSW Trustee and Guardian provides secure storage for documents such as wills. You can complete an online enquiry form to find a will in their database.

If you find more than one will, the most recent one cancels any previous one(s) made by the deceased.

faqs.a: A will is a legal document that sets out how someone wants their assets distributed after they die.
People usually keep a copy of their will at one or more of the following locations: solicitors, accountants/financial advisors, or NSW Trustee and Guardian.

faqs.q: What happens if there is more than one will?
faqs.a: If you find more than one will, the most recent one cancels any previous one(s) made by the deceased.
